g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Half of rural KP students cost families Rs 7,000 a year or less; the top tenth spend Rs 25,000 or more
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: students in rural KP with education spending above zero (n = 4,912). Weighted by hhweight.
3 students outside Rs 100 to Rs 1,000,000 are excluded from the histogram; median and percentiles use all students.
